pages.name: Producer Tour
pages.text:
[Intro — Full Beat on Beat Bus: Half-Speed + Hall Reverb + Low-Pass Sweep]
Submerged full-beat intro (~550 Hz LPF + 100% Half-Speed)
Analog Pad (Dynamic EQ + 2-bar Stereo Phaser + Chorus)
Dark Vox (+1 st pitch-preserving stretch: 120 -> 136 BPM)
Low-Pass sweeps wide open into the dry drop
[Act I — Hard Sternum Kick + D#1 808 + 4-Layer Flam Clap]
Kick (95 Hz punch + 28 ms 808 pocket) + Warp sidechain ducking
Backbeat: pre-flammed Wide Clap + Clap Body + Crisp + Snare + Rev Clap
Hats 2093: 18% BNYX swing + cut-group choked Open Hat + triplet rolls
Woody D#3 turnaround flick on the last 16th
Ghost Bell enters (BBD Chorus + Warp 1/2-bar Reverse + Tape Dub Delay)
Parallel Space send bus adds shared 3D hall bloom
808 Subtle Lift steps to G#1 (iv) for one bar
Beat Bus Low-Pass + Reverb dunk melts Hook into Verse
[Verse — Minimal D#1 Sub Pillow & Open Vocal Pocket]
Bare 1-hit-per-bar D#1 808 + 3-layer Clap & Rimshot
Vocal insert (Ins 12) armed in D#m: Denoiser -> Rider -> Tune -> EQ -> FET -> De-ess


Swung Nocturne Hats & Kick re-enter for Verse B



[Beat Switch — Half-Time Cathedral Wash -> 380 ms Silence Cut]
Entire Beat Bus drops into 100% Half-Speed + swelling Hall Reverb

Low-Pass creeps upward (500 Hz -> 1.45 kHz) building tension
380 ms digital-zero silence vacuum wipes all tails before Beat 1
[Act II — Reversed Analog Pad Flip + Weeping Moog Lead]
Analog Pad flipped backwards (Clip rev: true) over D#1 808


Woody D#3 808 turnaround inflection
Analog Glide enters: unison saw Moog portamento + automated cutoff


Half-Speed + Low-Pass slingshot (+1 dB makeup) into Climax
[Climax — Forward Pad + Dark Vox + Ghost Bell + Analog Glide]
All harmonic layers unite; Kick/Snare slice through via Warp pocket

Bar 35 G#1 bass lift -> dark D#1 resolution

[Outro — Underwater Half-Time Fade]
Beat Bus submerges back into Half-Speed + Reverb

Low-Pass closes to 180 Hz with S-curve fade to silence

pages.name: Vocal Pad (D#m)
pages.text:
[Verse — 136 BPM · D# minor (Ins 12 armed with live Pitch Correct)]
midnight chrome on the windowpane
low tide hummin' through the heavy rain
keep the circle quiet, keep the vision plain
every shadow movin' in a slower lane
[Verse B — Drums In]
step out clean when the filter breaks
cold neon glow on the silver lakes
no false moves, yeah we know the stakes
let the sub talk back till the ceiling shakes
